decision: Does TensorLBM's double-distribution thermal LBM (D2Q9 velocity + D2Q5 temperature, Guo Boussinesq forcing) reproduce the de Vahl Davis (1983) Ra=1e5 benchmark within the owner accuracy standard (<15%), and does it reach the platform's 3% caliber?
alternatives: A: literature-lineage anchor (de Vahl Davis 1983 Table 1) + converged multi-grid run of the repo library
B: OSS-source anchor (pylbm / hschwane / Maarten-vd-Sande_lbm in ~/oss-cache) — REJECTED a priori: survey found no thermal double-distribution natural-convection implementation (see oss_survey.json)

benchmark.name: differentially heated square cavity (DHC), side-heated
benchmark.geometry: unit square, left wall T=1, right wall T=0, top/bottom adiabatic, no-slip walls
benchmark.reference_source: de Vahl Davis G. (1983) Natural convection of air in a square cavity: a bench mark numerical solution. Int. J. Numer. Methods Fluids 3(3):249-264, Table 1 (p.257)
benchmark.secondary_reference_note: u_max/v_max are transcription-marked WITHHELD: the repo carries 34.72/68.60 in two independent tables (src/tensorlbm/heat_convection_benchmarks.py, src/tensorlbm/thermal_verification.py) and the audit trail docs/audit_m15466_ra1e5.md records literature 34.73/68.59 (0.03%/0.015% apart, i.e. rounding). No offline PDF was available to re-transcribe, so the primary gate is Nu_mean only.

control_case.name: same cavity at Ra=1e4 (already promoted as benchmarks/verified/cavity_natural_convection)
control_case.role: must reproduce the verified anchor; guards against a broken setup

metrics.primary: nu_grad2 = -dT/dx * H / dT averaged along both isothermal walls (library nusselt_number mode=grad2)

predeclared_thresholds.convergence_gate: |Nu(N=128) - Nu(N=96)| / Nu(N=96) <= 2.0% (two-resolution span) AND |Nu(N=96) - Nu(N=64)| <= |Nu(N=64) - Nu_ref| (monotone approach)
predeclared_thresholds.stopping_rule: run each grid until the library steady detector fires (5 consecutive |dNu| < 1e-3 per 2000-step window) or 400000 steps, whichever first; no threshold may be relaxed after seeing results
predeclared_thresholds.exclusions: none; every completed grid is reported, including non-converged ones

confounders: D2Q5 temperature stencil has a first-order (diffusive) error that grows with Ra; expected bias is NEGATIVE Nu at coarse N
half-way bounce-back walls make the effective cavity length H=nx (library convention), 1 lattice unit larger than the nominal nx; this is declared, not tuned
analysis_plan: analyze.py recomputes every error and every gate flag from the raw run JSONs; no number is typed by hand. Figures from figures.py read the same JSONs.
